text: The legal notice of the CENTURY 21 Martinot Immobilier group site names its Troyes agency MARTINOT IMMOBILIER TROYES, a SARL with capital of 204 000 euros registered in Troyes (RCS 552 881 757), and says the group's agencies are legally and financially independent.
short: Groupe Martinot's Troyes agency is MARTINOT IMMOBILIER TROYES, a SARL registered in Troyes.
